name: grpc ingestion
rules: Map transport inputs to domain requests through explicit validation and ownership boundaries.
Preserve schema identity, ordering, correlation, completeness and rejected-input diagnostics.
Keep malformed or unsupported input explicit; do not convert it into absent or successful evidence.
verification: Review message-to-domain mapping, validation and error/status behavior.
Run focused ingestion fixtures for valid, invalid, incomplete, reordered and repeated inputs.
